# Elvin Peters

> Toronto AI consultant and author of The Artificial Advantage. I help teams
> install AI that ships, run better Google Ads, and train staff to use AI well.

Independent consultant, not an agency: the person who scopes the work is the
person who does it. Commercial pages are published in English and Canadian
French; the French translations are marked below.

## Services - Put AI to work

- [The AI Workspace Setup](https://elvinpeters.com/setup/): Your AI set up on your real business, then handed over with a written manual and a recorded walkthrough so your team runs it without me. From $497.
- [AI Coaching](https://elvinpeters.com/ai-coaching/): One on one working sessions that get you directing AI with real confidence, with a system you keep using after we finish.
- [AI Workflow Build](https://elvinpeters.com/ai-workflow-build/): Pick one repetitive task and I build the AI workflow that runs it, then hand it over documented so your team owns it.

## Services - In-Person

- [Events](https://elvinpeters.com/services/events/): A talk built for your audience, whether that is a conference stage, a townhall or a company offsite, that sends people back to their desks able to use AI on real work.
- [Workshops](https://elvinpeters.com/team-ai-workshop/): A live two hour session that gets your whole team working from one reliable, shared way of using AI.

## Services - Consulting

- [Google Ads Audit](https://elvinpeters.com/google-ads-audit/): A specialist who ran $1.5M a month in paid search tears down your account and hands you a prioritized plan of exactly what to fix. From $499.
- [Google Ads Management](https://elvinpeters.com/google-ads/): Done for you paid search run by someone who has managed serious budgets, so every dollar stays accountable.
- [SEO Consulting](https://elvinpeters.com/seo/): Done for you SEO from someone who has driven real search results, month to month with no lock-in. From $1,200/month.
- [AIO Consulting](https://elvinpeters.com/aio-consulting/): A done-for-you build that gets ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews citing your business correctly. $1,800, one time.
- [Consulting by City](https://elvinpeters.com/consulting/): Google Ads, SEO and AIO consulting, remote, with dedicated pages for Toronto, Montreal, Vancouver and eight more Canadian cities.
